text: 中国10月官方制造业PMI 49.3，前值 50.1。 中国10月官方非制造业PMI 49.7，前值 50.2。 中国10月官方综合PMI 49.7，前值 50.7。
text_en: China's October official manufacturing PMI was 49.3 versus the previous 50.1. China's October official non-manufacturing PMI was 49.7 versus the previous 50.2. China's October official composite PMI was 49.7 versus the previous 50.7.
